Base class for per-subject model strategies

Source: R/tidyMS_R6_Modelling.R
StrategyBase.Rd

Base class for per-subject model strategies

Base class for per-subject model strategies

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Holds the fields, constructor and default methods shared by StrategyLM, StrategyRLM, StrategyLmer, StrategyRfit, StrategyLogistf and StrategyBinomial. A subclass implements the private fit(x) method and overrides only the methods that differ.

Public fields

formula

model formula

model_name

name of model

anova_df

ANOVA extractor, see AnovaExtractor
